<thought>We need to compare the observed isotopic pattern (a series of peaks from m/z ≈ 127.10 down to ≈ 132.11 with intensities decreasing roughly geometrically) to the known isotopic distributions of common elements. By retrieving the isotopic distributions for likely candidates (e.g., Xe, Te, Sn, etc.) we can see which element matches the monotonic decreasing pattern and the mass range. This will let us definitively identify the element(s) present.</thought>
<action>retrieve_isotope_distribution</action>
<action_input>{"element": "Xe"}</action_input>
